notes.title: Update 0.1.1 is released
notes.notes:
Dear players

we released update 0.1.1 a few minutes ago.

It includes:

 questmarkers and descriptions for the next objective(s)
 improved lighting (added fog and made the mood/atmosphere a bit darker generally)
 the bushes and the visuals of grass are improved
  The Sirister Mogun Rifle (Ammo type: Plasma) (It is hidden inside a chimney. I will post a screenshot with a hint later)
 some eastereggs:
        [spoiler]a gherkin, that hops around and beats you . It has infinite HP, but if you just walk away some distance it will leave you alone.	[/spoiler]
    [spoiler]a fish (flounder) you can pick up and use as weapon. It is inside the boat when you walk down to the water in deathworld 1 [/spoiler]

 improved bullet impact sparks and holes on metal
 scratches on the glass of Elons helmet
 a flashlight for illuminating dark areas like the sewers level
 an "interesting" jumpscare in the first part of Dead World (will post an screenshot with hint too)

notes.title: Update finished but delayed
notes.notes:
We finished the update with everything you saw in the announcement, but we've got a problem now. Unity has updated its Scripting API so the base game still works alone, but to function with the new update all of the scripts need to be remade. We expect around 2-2.5 for this.
Sorry for the delay. Have fun :) 

good morning, good evening and good night
ːKhappyː

notes.title: We're working on the first patch (0.1.1) for Nukklerma:Robot Warfare
notes.notes:
KerboGames is working on a patch that will improve Nukklerma with the most important stuff (but also some easter eggs/fun stuff), thats missing in the game right now.
Release date is not set yet but it should be done in around 2 weeks maybe earlier.
It will add:

   questmarkers and descriptions for the next objective(s)
   improved lighting (fog and  a bit darker atmosphere generally)
   bushes and the look of grass is improved
   Sirister Mogun (Plasma rifle) 
   some eastereggs
    
          [spoiler]a gherkin, that hops around and chases and beats you. It has infinite HP, but if you just walk away some distance it will leave you alone.	[/spoiler]
    [spoiler]a fish (flounder) you can pick up and use as weapon. [/spoiler]
  
    improved bullet impact sparks and holes on metal

    scratches on the glass of Elons helmet
   a flashlight for illuminating dark areas like the sewers level
   an "interesting" jumpscare in the first part of Dead World
